verdict.rationale: Stripe's automation features (Billing recurring payments, webhooks, revenue recovery) are payment-domain automations, not a general-purpose scheduler for arbitrary recurring jobs/workflows that an AI-native user could configure. No evidence of a cron-like job scheduler, workflow orchestration, or scheduled task API exists in the pack. missing for 10: any documented scheduling primitive, cron/workflow orchestration feature, or API for scheduling arbitrary recurring jobs beyond billing-specific recurrence.
